title: Ending a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: Cancellation Terms
content:
Only the customer can end an active Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program (CGM program).

## Terms

1. Larkfield records the cancellation as a program cancellation request, and the program closes only when the customer personally confirms that request.
2. A confirmed cancellation closes the program with the closure reason customer discontinued, or changed supplier when the customer states they are moving these supplies to another supplier.
3. A cancellation of a program on hold is closed under the program's hold and closure rules.
4. Ending a program carries no fee and cancels nothing the customer already owes: the balance stays payable, credit balances are still refunded under the patient account rules, and unopened items delivered within the return window stay returnable under the returns rules.
5. Authorized units remaining on a closed program lapse and are never shipped; a later restart needs a new referral and a new program.
6. A package already shipped is not recalled.

## Closure reason by statement

| What the customer states when confirming the cancellation of an active program | Closure reason |
|---|---|
| They are moving these supplies to another supplier | Changed supplier |
| Any other confirmed cancellation | Customer discontinued |

## Basis questions

- *Does a recorded cancellation request close the program by itself?* No. The program closes only when the customer personally confirms the request.
- *What happens to units still authorized on the program?* Once the program is closed they lapse and are never shipped.
- *Does a balance disappear with the program?* No. The balance stays payable after the program ends.
